title: Новый паспорт и усы  (New Passport and Mustache)

segments.t: Chef Barinov asks if their upcoming wedding was also a cover, and Elena assures him her love is real. She gives him five minutes to say goodbye to his daughter Katya and tells him to shave off his famous mustache.
Не волнуйся, я позабочусь о них.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.

'And what about our wedding?' Around the moment and wedding, Barinov wants to know where Elena really stands. In Russian, he does not need helper words like "do" or "did"—rising pitch alone turns it into a question.

'Was that also your cover story?' Asking whether that also Elena's cover story cuts straight through the tension between Barinov and Elena. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
'No, I truly love you.' Between the moment and the wedding, Elena gives Barinov a quick, grounded response.

'That is why I am helping you escape.' Admitting that that is why she is helping Barinov escape shows Elena being honest for a change. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.

'Take this, it is your new passport.' Taking this it is Barinov's new passport is how Elena lays out the situation for Barinov. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'You must leave the country urgently.' Because Barinov must leave the country urgently, Elena treats the matter as settled.
'Along the line you will reach the airport.' Explaining that along the line Barinov will reach the airport lays the cards on the table for Barinov.
'People are tied up in the room over there.' Barinov mentions that people are tied up in the room over there so Elena sees what is at stake.
Не волнуйся, я позабочусь о них.
'Do not worry, I will take care of them.' Claiming that do not worry she will take care of them sounds confident, even if Barinov has doubts.

'I need to say goodbye to Katya.' Needing to say goodbye to Katya moves the conversation forward without extra drama. Russian packs the whole idea of what is allowed or needed into one impersonal word at the front.

'Alright, I give you a little time.' Elena explains that Alright she gives Barinov a little time, keeping her voice calm and direct. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.

'And do not forget to shave off your mustache.' Realizing that do not forget to shave off Barinov's mustache changes how Elena handles the situation. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Не волнуйся, я позабочусь о них.
Freshly shaved, Chef Barinov runs into the kitchen and dining hall, where the dream becomes so absurd he finally realizes none of it is real. Until next time!
